about.title: About Mini Games
about.subtitle: A passion for games, a platform for everyone
about.mission_p1: Mini Games was born from a simple passion: creating fun and accessible games for everyone. We believe the best gaming moments are those we share, whether for a few minutes of relaxation or hours of challenge.
about.mission_p2: Each game is accessible for free and without pay-to-win mechanics. To maintain our servers and keep creating new challenges, we integrate a few advertisements. We strive to balance them so that your gaming enjoyment remains our top priority.
about.milestone_1_desc: Launch of Mini Games with a strong promise: instant, free games with no intrusive mechanics. Introduction of our first classics like Snow Digger and Tic Tac Toe, powered by a PWA architecture that works anywhere, even 100% offline.
about.milestone_2_desc: A major technical leap with the launch of a real-time multiplayer room system (Lost Below, Battleship). The experience becomes multi-sensory with dynamic background music and global leaderboards to challenge the world.
about.milestone_3_desc: Arrival of a full community ecosystem: custom profiles, XP and level progression, daily challenges, and unlockable themes. To connect players across the globe, the platform introduced full multilingual support.
about.milestone_4_desc: Major expansion with all-new experiences: deep simulation with The Race Manager (team management, weather, driver contracts), space physics in Rocketeer, 3D exploration with 3D Maze, and revived classics (Snake, Ball Rush, Sudoku, Crosswords). The library now exceeds 25 original games.
about.milestone_5_desc: Mini Games never stops evolving! We continue crafting fresh game concepts, refining mobile performance, and developing exciting new competitive and co-op modes. The adventure is just beginning.
about.tech_intro: All our games are built with modern web technologies to ensure optimal performance on all devices.
about.contact_p: A bug to report? A suggestion? Feel free to contact us!
about.privacy_p: We respect your privacy. To learn more, check our privacy policy.

manual.page1_content:
Drag parts from the catalog. They snap to connection nodes.

  • Core: Every rocket needs a Cockpit, Fuel, and Engine.
  • Staging: Use Decouplers to drop empty tanks and ignite the next phase.
  • TWR: Thrust-to-Weight Ratio must be > 1.0 to lift off.
manual.page2_content:
• Shift / Ctrl Throttle Control
  • Space Next Stage / Decouple
  • T Cycle Time Scale (1x, 2x, 4x, 8x, 15x)
  • C Center Camera
  • Note: Manual rotation is disabled. Balancing is done via design!
manual.page3_content:
• Distance: 1¢ per 100m reached.
  • Speed Bonus: Faster missions earn up to +10% extra!
  • Milestones: Massive grants for reaching 100km, 500km, etc.
  • R&D: Spend credits to improve ISP, Thrust, and Science.
manual.page4_content:
• Torque: If thrust is off-center from the Center of Mass (CoM), the rocket will tilt.
  • Aerodynamics: Air density drops with altitude. Fins help stabilize in low atmosphere.
  • Heat: High-speed descent in atmosphere is dangerous!
